name: aicraft
description: AiCraft is a software factory in your repository: it coordinates the work, keeps the requirements and decisions in ordinary files, and checks the code before shipping so you can see what was built and how it was verified. Skills: discover (scenario discovery), product-review (independent capability review), trace (revision-bound provenance and navigation), tune (repository configuration), cast (project framing), spec (feature and quick contracts), draft (task plans with MSW), forge (reviewed-task implementation and authorized task PRs), review (report-only plan, code, and evidence review), land (authorized finalization and tracker closure), foreman (named-state delivery coordination), temper (local retrospective production), hone (prompt refinement), distill (prompt distillation), and msw (MSW Kernel document judgment).
